title: The sunflower green room
alt: Sunflowers, velvet and rattan fill a lush vintage conservatory.
description: A lived-in interior with tactile furniture, patterned cushions and filtered garden light.
prompt: A sophisticated editorial interior photograph of a vintage conservatory. An enormous loose arrangement of sunflowers stands in a blue ceramic floor vase beside a faded velvet armchair; embroidered cushions, scattered art books without readable text, rattan furniture and a tiled floor add tactile detail. Tall windows reveal a lush overgrown garden. Natural sunlight and soft green shadows, coherent furniture geometry, refined lived-in atmosphere, no people.
